Dia 1.47.1 "Dia (handshake) Notion" — 2026-09-03
Slug: https://www.diabrowser.com/release-notes/Notion   (NOT constructible from the version)
Audited 2026-09-28 (backlog item from the 2026-09-27 scan state).

Capability: Dia searches ACROSS connected tools and WRITES the collected result into a
Notion document. Verbatim framing from the page: "ask and Dia wrangles Slack dms, long
email threads, and messy Google Docs (and more) with ease."

Worked example given on the page (verbatim): "Searching across our tools, find me
conversations where Susan's communication and leadership skills excelled this Summer,
collecting it all in a Notion doc for me to review."

*** SIGNIFICANCE: this is the first Dia release where a tool is a WRITE TARGET, not just a
    read source. The 1.49.0 Microsoft/Slack/Zoom/Salesforce tools reported 2026-09-27 were
    all read-oriented. Notion here is an egress destination. ***
*** Second distinct property: CROSS-TOOL AGGREGATION. The example query fans out over
    Slack DMs + email + Google Docs in one request and concentrates the result into a
    single document — i.e. an employee-performance dossier assembled from four separately
    governed systems, produced client-side, landing in a fifth. ***

Not documented on the page: authorization model, scopes requested against Notion, admin
control, audit surface, or whether the write is scoped to a user-owned page.
